extDescription: Save, organize, and quickly reopen your Path of Exile Trade searches.

folder.shareLiveDesc: Generate a key to share this folder. Anyone with the key can see and edit every bookmark in it, changes sync both ways in real time.
folder.shareOnceDesc: Send a copy of this folder's data as it is right now. No further sync — your folder's state doesn't change at all.
folder.shareOnceResultText: Send this key to the recipient. It's a one-time snapshot, no further sync.
folder.shareActiveText: This folder is being shared. Anyone with the key below has full read/write access.
folder.joinModalDesc: Whoever shared the folder sent you a share key (from their Share dialog). Paste it here to view or sync their folder.
folder.joinOnceDetectedText: This is a one-time share. The data will be copied into a new folder, with no further sync.
folder.joinLiveDetectedText: This is a live share. Fork it for a static copy, or Join to keep syncing continuously.
folder.joinAlreadyExists: This folder is already shared or joined on this device.
folder.joinFailed: Couldn't join — check the key and try again.
folder.deleteDisabledTitle: You must keep at least one folder
folder.empty: Folder is empty. Open a search and pick this folder to save it.

history.empty: No recent searches yet. Every trade page you open gets recorded here.

watchlist.empty: Nothing watched yet. Use the eye icon on a saved search to watch it.
watchlist.limitReached: You can watch at most {max} searches at once. Stop watching one to add another.
watchlist.notificationBody: {title} has new listings on the trade site.

priceHistory.title: Price history
priceHistory.notEnoughData: Not enough data to chart yet — need at least 2 snapshots.

settings.statFilterButtonsDesc: Show +/− buttons next to each mod line in results to add it to Stat Filters.
settings.propertyFilterButtonsDesc: Show +/− buttons next to armour & weapon properties on an item to filter by that value.
settings.priceLabelsDesc: Show the chaos/divine equivalent right next to every listing in the search results.
settings.highlightSearchedModsDesc: Highlight mod lines in results that match your current Stat Filters, so you can scan results faster.
settings.backupDesc: Export every folder, bookmark, and history entry to a JSON file. Importing replaces the current data.
settings.shortcutHintAfter: shortcut toggles the panel right on the trade page. The extension never sends your queries or account data anywhere.

welcome.title: Welcome to Exile Trade Companion
welcome.body: This extension saves, organizes, and quickly reopens your Path of Exile Trade searches — the UI reuses the trade site's own font and colors, so the panel feels like part of the site. Walk through a few steps to see what it can do.

save.title: Save the search you have open into a folder
save.body: Open a search on pathofexile.com/trade, click the extension icon, then pick a folder — the search gets pinned with its median price, one click away whenever you need it again.

panel.title: A floating panel right on the trade page
panel.body: A vertical tab docked to the right edge of the trade page opens a full panel with folders, recent search history, and settings — no need to leave the page to manage searches. Alt+Shift+B toggles it any time.

statFilter.title: Add stat filters straight from results
statFilter.body: Hover a mod line in the trade results and click the + that appears — that stat gets added to Stat Filters on your current search instantly, no retyping the mod name.

propertyFilter.title: Filter by armour & weapon properties
propertyFilter.body: The same + button works on weapon and armour properties on an item's row — add a filter condition straight from what you're already looking at instead of hunting through a long filter list.

priceHistory.title: Track price history
priceHistory.body: Every time a saved search is reopened, its median price gets captured as a snapshot. The price history chart shows how the market moved over time, right inside the saved search.

shareFolder.title: Share a folder with friends
shareFolder.body: Live share keeps both sides in sync in real time, or one-time share sends a static snapshot — no account needed, just a share key.

shortcut.title: Ready to trade
shortcut.body: Alt+Shift+B toggles the panel any time; your data stays on this device (chrome.storage.local) and can be backed up or restored as JSON from Settings. Time to start searching.
